GomokuGame.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes the game state by storing the board size, creating a square board filled with spaces, and setting the current player to 'X'." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> board_size </REF>: int "The number of rows and columns for the square game board."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Store the provided board_size parameter into self.board_size. RESULT self.board_size]
            [COMMAND Create self.board using a nested list comprehension: for each iteration in range(board_size), create a separate inner list containing board_size space characters; assign this result to self.board. For board_size zero or negative, the result is an empty list. RESULT self.board]
            [COMMAND Set self.current_player to the constant string 'X'. RESULT self.current_player]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
GomokuGame.make_move:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Places the current player's mark on an empty board cell, toggles the current player, and returns True if the move was placed, otherwise returns False." make_move]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> row </REF>: int "Row index of the board cell to mark."
        <REF> col </REF>: int "Column index of the board cell to mark."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> move_made </REF>: bool "True if the move was placed successfully; otherwise False."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read the board cell at self.board[row][col] and compare it to the space character ' '. RESULT is_empty]
            [COMMAND If is_empty is true, assign self.current_player to self.board[row][col]. RESULT cell_marked]
            [COMMAND If is_empty is true, set self.current_player to 'O' when the previous value is 'X', otherwise set it to 'X'. RESULT player_switched]
            [COMMAND If is_empty is true, exit the method and return True. RESULT return_true]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: is_empty is false, meaning self.board[row][col] is not equal to ' '.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Exit the method and return False. RESULT return_false]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
GomokuGame.check_winner:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Scans the board in row-major order and returns the first player symbol that has five consecutive pieces in any of four directions, or None if no winner exists." check_winner]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: str or None "The first player symbol that forms five consecutive pieces in any checked direction, or None if no such symbol is found."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign directions to the list of four constant offset tuples: (0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1), and (1, -1). RESULT directions]
            [COMMAND For each row from 0 through self.board_size - 1 inclusive, in ascending order. RESULT row]
            [COMMAND Within the current row loop, for each col from 0 through self.board_size - 1 inclusive, in ascending order. RESULT col]
            [COMMAND Within the current row and column loop, inspect the board cell self.board[row][col]; if it is the space character ' ', skip all remaining checks for this cell and continue to the next column. RESULT occupied_cell]
            [COMMAND For each direction in directions, in the order (0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1), (1, -1). RESULT direction]
            [COMMAND Within the current row, column, and direction loop, call self._check_five_in_a_row(row, col, direction). If the call returns true, immediately return self.board[row][col] from check_winner, short-circuiting all remaining loops. RESULT winner]
            [COMMAND After the direction loop completes for an occupied cell without returning, continue with the next direction, column, or row as appropriate. RESULT scan_continue]
            [COMMAND After all row and column iterations complete without finding a winning direction, return None. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
GomokuGame._check_five_in_a_row:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Determines whether the starting board cell at row, col plus the next four cells in the given direction remain within the board and all contain the same symbol." _check_five_in_a_row]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The current board object providing the board grid and the board_size value."
        <REF> row </REF>: int "Starting board row index."
        <REF> col </REF>: int "Starting board column index."
        <REF> direction </REF>: tuple[int, int] "Two-element direction vector whose components are used to move one cell per step."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool "True when the starting cell and all four following cells in the given direction are the same symbol and are inside the board; False if any of the four following cells is out of bounds or contains a different symbol."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Unpack the two-element direction vector into dx and dy. RESULT dx, dy]
            [COMMAND Initialize count to the integer 1, counting the starting cell at row, col as the first matching cell. RESULT count]
            [COMMAND Set symbol to self.board[row][col], establishing the reference symbol for all later comparisons. RESULT symbol]
            [COMMAND For each integer i from 1 through 4 inclusive, compute new_row = row + dx * i and new_col = col + dy * i. RESULT new_row, new_col]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over i, when both the board-boundary check and the symbol-match check pass, increment count by 1. RESULT count]
            [COMMAND After the loop has completed all four iterations without returning False, evaluate and return the boolean expression count == 5. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: During any loop iteration i from 1 through 4 inclusive, the computed new_row or new_col is outside the valid board bounds 0 <= index < self.board_size.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False immediately and do not process any remaining loop iterations or the final count == 5 expression. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: During any loop iteration i from 1 through 4 inclusive, the board cell self.board[new_row][new_col] does not equal the reference symbol.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False immediately and do not process any remaining loop iterations or the final count == 5 expression. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
